description: Solo founders, indie hackers and small startup teams building SaaS and AI tools. Mostly 22-35, all over the world, and they follow productivity and startup creators on Instagram.

archetypes.label: bootstrapped SaaS founder
archetypes.occupation: founder of a two-person invoicing SaaS
archetypes.bio: Left a corporate job to build a product and checks revenue every morning. Follows build-in-public founders and is allergic to fluff.

archetypes.label: indie hacker
archetypes.bio: Ships a new side project most months and tries every new AI tool on launch day.

archetypes.label: productivity nerd
archetypes.bio: Rebuilds a Notion system every few months, watches workflow videos at lunch, and saves anything that might save time.

archetypes.label: AI-curious product manager
archetypes.occupation: product manager at a fintech company
archetypes.bio: Evaluates AI tools for the team and posts good demos in Slack. Suspicious of anything that looks staged.

archetypes.label: first-time founder
archetypes.occupation: computer science student building a startup
archetypes.bio: Applying to accelerators, watches startup content nonstop, and loves memes about founder life.

archetypes.label: freelance designer
archetypes.bio: Judges every demo on its interface first. Saves tools that could speed up client work.

archetypes.label: growth marketer
archetypes.occupation: growth lead at a B2B startup
archetypes.bio: Studies hooks and ad creatives for a living, so every trick in a video gets noticed. Comments when something is genuinely clever.

archetypes.label: remote engineer
archetypes.bio: Rolls eyes at hype, but shares tools that genuinely save engineering time in the team chat.

archetypes.label: creator turned founder
archetypes.occupation: YouTuber who sells an online course
archetypes.bio: Builds in public, follows other creators, and comments and shares generously to grow the network.

archetypes.label: busy agency owner
archetypes.bio: Drowning in email and client requests. Watches anything that promises a few hours back each week.

archetypes.label: no-code builder
archetypes.bio: Automates everything with no-code tools and shares useful finds in WhatsApp groups of other builders.

archetypes.label: student founder
archetypes.bio: Reads startup news on the train, follows investors on Instagram, and saves anything about pricing or fundraising.
